subject: Web Development
title: Digital Identity and Self-Sovereignty
description: One-minute skill: Digital Identity and Self-Sovereignty.

hook.text: On today's web, Google and Facebook own your digital identity. You just rent it.

buildup.text: Self-sovereign identity means you control your credentials without relying on any platform.

discovery.text: Decentralized identifiers (DIDs) and verifiable credentials let you prove facts without a middleman.

twist.text: Most users don't care about identity sovereignty. Convenience still wins over control.

climax.text: The tension between convenience and control will define who owns digital identity in the future.

punchline.text: Own your identity, or someone else will.
